_run: Step 4 of How it works, without callouts (2026-09-29). Large docs is captured at 1440 x 900 (docs/ASSETS.md §1.2). Serve site/ (python3 tools/serve.py <port> site; the URLs below use 51458, change the port to yours), then: PORT=95xx W=1440 H=900 DPR=2 STEPS=tools/step-captures/large-document-extraction.json node tools/step-mocks/cap.mjs about:blank <outdir>; then sips --resampleWidth 1744 and sips -s format jpeg -s formatOptions 82 into site/assets/img/steps/. Flow: upload the Meridian agreement, open it, apply the suggested fix on the flagged Volume discounts tier, Approve all, close the row details, collapse the group, then page the viewer back twice (its own Prev button) to page 7, the Routine cleaning rate card, so step 3's page-9 highlight is not in the frame.

eval: document.querySelector('#toast').hidden = true; JSON.stringify({step: 4, page: document.querySelector('#pg-input').value, highlight: !!document.querySelector('#paper .is-hi'), status: document.querySelector('#meta-status').textContent, openGroups: document.querySelectorAll('.group.is-open').length, details: !document.querySelector('#details').hidden, approveAllDisabled: document.querySelector('#approve-all').disabled})
